style.backgroundSystem: bone linen weave #F4F1EC with soft natural folds shading into #9A8FA6, matte, low contrast, shallow depth so no pattern repeats across the frame
style.iconSystem: rust-orange #B4593A solid dots threaded on a hairline #9A8FA6 line, evenly spaced, one dot per label, no filled shapes, no gradient icons, no emoji
style.lightingSystem: one large diffused key from front-top at 5200K, low contrast, broad soft fill, gentle elongated contact shadow under every object, no hard specular, calm spa-like mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft maternal-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of bone linen background #F4F1EC, lavender grey-purple secondary #9A8FA6, deep grey-purple text #4A4356 and one rust-orange accent #B4593A; neutral 5200K tone; one humanist rounded sans-serif family; consistent hairline plus rust-orange dot icon style; bone linen and pale oak wood surfaces; soft low-contrast front-top lighting with gentle contact shadows; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes, keep #F4F1EC / #9A8FA6 / #4A4356 / #B4593A only
no mixed fonts, one rounded sans-serif family only
no random backgrounds, only bone linen #F4F1EC and pale oak tray #C9AE8C
no inconsistent lighting, always 5200K soft front-top low contrast
no mismatched icon styles, only a hairline line plus a rust-orange dot
no brand name, logo, wordmark, watermark, QR code or membership badge
no price, discount, coupon, shipping time, weight, size, capacity, sheet count or pH number
no material grade, origin, imported claim or patent count
no certification, award, test report, registration number or executive standard
no doctor, hospital or laboratory endorsement, no treatment or prevention claim, no age range, no material safety claim
no rating, sales volume or percentage comparison curve
no identifiable infant face, no infant alone in frame, a caregiver is always present
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the pouch, product always centered on the oak tray at identical scale and placement across the set, verticals kept truly vertical, no cropped bottoms, no floating product, no duplicated product elements
style.surfaceSystem: pale oak wood tray #C9AE8C with quiet grain laid over bone linen #F4F1EC; every object rests on a real surface with a visible contact shadow and is never floating
style.typography: a single humanist rounded sans-serif family at medium to semibold weight with generous letter spacing, never mixing serif, handwritten, retro or display faces
